mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM road_centerline WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> '' ORDER BY name
SELECT DISTINCT bld_usage FROM building_footprint WHERE bld_usage IS NOT NULL AND bld_usage <> '' ORDER BY bld_usage
SELECT MIN(lc) AS "min", MAX(lc) AS "max" FROM building_footprint WHERE lc IS NOT NULL
SELECT ST_X(p) AS "lon", ST_Y(p) AS "lat" FROM ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{x}, #{y}), 4544), 4326) AS p
SELECT ST_X(c) AS "x", ST_Y(c) AS "y" FROM ST_Centroid(ST_GeomFromText(#{wkt}, 4544)) AS c
SELECT ST_X(c) AS "x", ST_Y(c) AS "y" FROM ST_Centroid( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{json}), 4326), 4544) ) AS c
